title: Shell Functions
title_vi: Xây Dựng Hàm Trong Shell Script
overview: Define functions, pass parameters, handle return values, use local variables, and build calculator functions.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice the reviewed shell concepts below. Instructions are independently written; functional requirements follow the linked public lesson.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành các khái niệm shell bên dưới. Hướng dẫn được biên soạn lại; yêu cầu chức năng theo bài công khai được liên kết.

sections.title: Creating Your First Shell Function
sections.content:
Define and invoke greet inside functions.sh.

`~/project/functions.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
greet() { echo "Hello, World!"; }
greet
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/functions.sh
~/project/functions.sh 
```

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/functions.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['greet']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in ['Hello, World!']),result.stdout
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Return Values from Functions
sections.content:
Capture get_square output and compare with a function changing global RESULT.

`~/project/functions.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
get_square() { echo $(($1 * $1)); }
RESULT=0
set_global_result() { RESULT=$(($1 * $1)); }
square_of_5=$(get_square 5)
echo "The square of 5 is $square_of_5"
set_global_result 6
echo "The square of 6 is $RESULT"
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/functions.sh
~/project/functions.sh 
```

Hứng đầu ra get_square rồi so sánh với hàm thay đổi biến toàn cục RESULT.

sections.title: Understanding Variable Scope
sections.content:
Observe GLOBAL_VAR inside/outside a function; local LOCAL_VAR disappears outside it.

`~/project/functions.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
GLOBAL_VAR="I'm global"
demonstrate_scope() {
  local LOCAL_VAR="I'm local"
  echo "Inside function: GLOBAL_VAR = $GLOBAL_VAR"
  echo "Inside function: LOCAL_VAR = $LOCAL_VAR"
}
demonstrate_scope
echo "Outside function: GLOBAL_VAR = $GLOBAL_VAR"
echo "Outside function: LOCAL_VAR = $LOCAL_VAR"
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/functions.sh
~/project/functions.sh 
```

    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in ['3 + 5 = 8', '5 - 1 = 4', '4 * 6 = 24', 'Invalid operation.']),result.stdout
    assert result.returncode == 1
